Originated in Eastern Europe as part of klezmer musician cant (Klezmer-loshn). In its original sense, the word only applied to non-Jewish males. Strom (2002) lists "zhlobukhe-elzet" as a synonym, "zhlobevke" and "zlobike" (זלאָביקע) as female counterparts. The precise nature of the semantic leap from "manger, crib" to "boorish goy" remains unclear. In any case, by the year 1869, it had become common enough to be included in a Russian-Yiddish dictionary published in Zhytomyr. Jewish immigrants brought the word to the United States, where it is best known under the form schlub.

senses.vi: sự tàn; lúc xế; sự suy yếu

senses.definition: The period when the bright part of the moon is becoming smaller.

examples.en: The moon was on the wane as the night progressed.
examples.vi: Mặt trăng dần khuyết khi đêm dần trôi qua.

thesaurus.definition: a gradual decline (in size or strength or power or number)

vi_block: Sự tàn; lúc tàn, lúc xế, lúc hết thời.

examples:
1913, Michael Ott, The Catholic Encyclopedia, "Wenzel Anton Kaunitz",
His influence which was on the wane during the reign of Joseph II grew still less during the reign of Leopold II (1790-2).
wiktionary.gloss: A gradual diminution in power, value, intensity etc.
The lunar phase during which the sun seems to illuminate less of the moon as its sunlit area becomes progressively smaller as visible from Earth.
The end of a period.

examples:
2002, Peter Ross, Appraisal and Repair of Timber Structures, p. 11,
Sapwood, or even bark, may appear on the corners, or may have been cut off, resulting in wane, or missing timber.
wiktionary.gloss: A rounded corner caused by lack of wood, often showing bark.
A child.

blocks.etymology: From Middle English wanen, wanien, from Old English wanian, wonian, from Proto-West Germanic *wanōn, from Proto-Germanic *wanōną.

senses.definition: To become gradually weaker, smaller, or less important.

examples.en: Public interest in the scandal began to wane quickly.
examples.vi: Sự quan tâm của công chúng đối với vụ bê bối bắt đầu suy giảm nhanh chóng.

senses.definition: To appear smaller each night after being full.

examples.en: The moon slowly waned over the next two weeks.
examples.vi: Mặt trăng dần dần khuyết đi trong hai tuần tiếp theo.

thesaurus.definition: grow smaller
become smaller
decrease in phase

wiktionary.gloss: To progressively lose its splendor, value, ardor, power, intensity etc.; to decline.
For light to dim or diminish in strength.
For the Moon to pass through the phases of its monthly cycle where its surface is less and less visible.
Said of a time period that comes to an end.

idioms.gloss: To progress cyclically through various phases, such as growth and senescence.
in a period of decrease or decline

examples.en: Kings once filled war chests with gold.
examples.vi: Các vua xưa từng chất đầy vàng vào quỹ chiến tranh.
